props.title: The risk commandments

items.sub: So no single trade can seriously hurt you. This is the master rule.

items.h: Every position has a stop-loss, set in advance
items.sub: Decide where you're wrong before you enter, not after.

items.h: Cap your total loss for a single day
items.sub: If you hit it, the bot stops. Live to trade tomorrow.

items.h: Don't put all your risk in one bet
items.sub: Correlated positions are secretly one big position.
Wild markets deserve smaller bets, not braver ones.

props.caption: Returns are what you hope for. Risk is what you actually control.
